name: strict
title: Strict - maximum; some features go away
description: Average plus: Phone Link and more apps removed (To Do, Quick Assist, new Outlook, Xbox app, Xbox Speech-to-Text), clipboard history off, Defender network protection BLOCK and ransomware folders AUDIT, the Office / Adobe attack-surface rules too (AUDIT), all safe network services off, password + lockout rules, Lockdown app permissions, Bluetooth network / Wi-Fi Direct / WAN Miniports off, the firewall baseline, drivers not through Windows Update, Store and Edge self-updates off. The update gate is NOT closed (your manual choice). Everything is recorded and can be undone in the Undo center.
